assertions.name: f_pn_strict_averaged
assertions.source: the sweep's BLIND_KEY, recomputed from z and h rather than read from a producer

assertions.name: f_pn_bring_color_weighted
assertions.source: the sweep's CANON_KEY, likewise

assertions.name: weight_form_bar_odd_worst_defect
assertions.source: every bar-even E gives a bar-odd offset; the criterion selects nothing inside the class

assertions.name: C1_confluence_worst_gap
assertions.source: C1 holds identically at q = 1 for every regular E -- vacuous as a selector

assertions.name: C1_approach_slope
assertions.source: f_pn - f_pp = -(1/2 - eps)h and h ~ 2(q-1), so the gap vanishes linearly with slope -1; recorded because mistaking this slope for a confluence failure is what the earlier revision of this check did

assertions.name: C2_bound_times_scale_is_one_half
assertions.source: |eps| <= 1/2 with eps = scale*E(q0) means the bound on |E(q0)| is exactly (1/2)/scale = 2/(q0*delta)

assertions.name: C2_excludes_no_candidate
assertions.source: the bound is |E(q0)| <= 1309.7495; the largest candidate here is 136, so C2 excludes none of them -- it is a sanity bound, not a selector

assertions.name: C3_bond_form_worst_residual
assertions.source: every eps yields a valid bond constant -- C3 is an identity, not a constraint

assertions.name: C4_geometric_E_diverges
assertions.source: the geometric-mean E has a double pole, so its offset is O(q-1), not O((q-1)^3): outside the regular class

assertions.name: geometric_mean_eq_z_over_q2
assertions.source: sqrt(z * bar z) = z/q^2 because bar z = z/q^4

assertions.name: geometric_mean_realised_by_eps
assertions.source: the geometric mean is an admissible convex bond

assertions.name: geometric_eps_bar_odd
assertions.source: so it satisfies the criterion, like the strict average

assertions.name: geometric_weights_are_convex
assertions.source: weights (p-p, n-n) = (0.44801814, 0.55198186) -- a genuine bond, not a formal solution

assertions.name: geometric_over_canonical_magnitude
assertions.source: the two derived candidates differ by two orders of magnitude AND in sign -- they are not variants of one convention

assertions.name: product_of_factors_eq_closed_form
assertions.source: f_pp*f_nn = (q/(q^2+1))^2, which is (z/q^2)^2 -- the reason the geometric mean is z/q^2

assertions.name: markov_trace_not_multiplicative_on_these_bonds
assertions.source: the product of the factors misses tau(1)=1 by more than 3/4; it could not do otherwise, since a bond and its inverse would need reciprocal traces

assertions.name: quarter_minus_product_is_a_square
assertions.source: 1/4 - f_pp*f_nn = ((q^2-1)/(2(q^2+1)))^2, so the product is <= 1/4 for EVERY q, equality only at q=1 (Lean: quarter_sub_fPP_mul_fNN)

assertions.name: arithmetic_mean_is_trace_of_skein_symmetriser
assertions.source: (f_pp+f_nn)/2 = z - h/2 = tau((sigma+sigma^-1)/2); the trace is linear, so the arithmetic mean of the factors IS the trace of a canonical element, and the geometric mean is the trace of nothing

assertions.name: an_E_is_selected
assertions.source: none of C1-C4 narrows the class; selecting an E from an isotope anchor would be a fit, and is not done. C2 is the only constraint that can exclude a candidate and it leaves 5 of 5 standing, so the class is not narrowed to one

description: The bar-odd repair class eps = q*delta*E/4 (E bar-even) is closed under every bar-even E, and four candidate narrowing constraints -- confluence, convex weights, the Markov bond form, and the cubic order of vanishing -- are each vacuous as selectors. Regular E confines the offset to O((q-1)^3); the geometric mean of the bar orbit, z/q^2, is O(q-1) and needs a double pole, so it is outside the class. No E is selected: that would be a fit.

data.arithmetic_vs_geometric: RESOLVED in favour of arithmetic as the structurally-backed choice (qou-s24v): the product-over-bonds argument for the geometric mean is unsound. f_pp and f_nn are the traces of sigma and sigma^-1, which are MUTUALLY INVERSE, so tau of their product is tau(1) = 1 while the product of their traces is <= 1/4 at every q. The closed form multiplies TRACES; there is no multiplicative structure at the factor level to take a midpoint in. The arithmetic mean, by contrast, IS the trace of the skein symmetriser (sigma+sigma^-1)/2, because the trace is linear. This does NOT establish eps = 0 physically; the colour-tube delta/4 sits on top either way.
